title: Useable Multishot
description: Makes Multishot and other arrow-based enchants useable!
body:
This simple datapack makes arrows not trigger invincibility frames, close-range Multishot crossbow is now a viable strategy, attempting to hit one target with all of the arrows.
Might have issues, let me know if any arise and I will fix them when possible.

Should not require any other mods.

For assistance: Contact me on Discord at 4x31theProtogen
